text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Mejiro family was invited to a dance 
party. I accompanied Mejiro Ramonu, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone looks even more composed than 
usual. It seems to be quite a prestigious 
party.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Is that trembling from the cold, or is it 
from fear, I wonder?
choice_data_list: Sorry, I just got swept up in the mood...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Get used to it. It happens all the time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, are you ready for the 
dance? I trust you will be escorting me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
We will now begin the dance time. Please 
proceed to the central dance floor.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The invited guests began gathering on the 
floor. I followed behind Mejiro Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Silence――...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder what's going on. The music 
isn't starting, no matter how long I wait.

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
"—My apologies, the wiring seems fine, 
but, well..."
choice_data_list: I wonder if something's gone wrong...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Well, now. One thing is certain, however—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Ending like this is such a buzzkill.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, Mejiro Ramonu walked 
straight into the center of the dance 
floor. Just as I was wondering what she 
was doing—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—*tap, tap, tap...*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amid the dead silence, her footsteps 
echoed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Tan, tap, tap— Tan, tap, tap—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before long, the footsteps became a light, 
upbeat rhythm—

text_block_list.name: Guest in a Suit
text_block_list.text: Is this... a waltz?

text_block_list.name: Guest in a Dress
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it seems that way, but... Why on 
earth—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thought the same thing— but that thought 
was instantly blown away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amid the silence, she danced alone. Yet 
she shone so brilliantly, I couldn't take 
my eyes off her.

text_block_list.name: Guest in a Dress
text_block_list.text:
...No, perhaps no reason is needed. Before 
such a breathtakingly beautiful figure...

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, applause for the lovely 
princess—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Countless eyes, burning with feverish 
passion.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"It seems this place has become somewhat 
enjoyable after all."
choice_data_list: That was such a lovely dance...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"It seems this place has become somewhat 
enjoyable after all."
choice_data_list: That was such a lovely dance...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Handling...? What a dry, flavorless word.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I had no intention of cleaning up 
someone else's mess. I simply followed my 
heart, that is all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It might not seem like much to her, but I 
still sincerely wanted to express my 
praise.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...How pure-hearted.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
However, if you daydream too much, you 
won't look very clever, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
If you are to be my dance partner, would 
you mind carrying yourself with dignity?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hurried to reply, steeling my expression 
for the dance.
